# Index

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-index.py from index/*.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Goal first: find the route, then take it. Outside sources come before anything built here;
this repo only keeps the combinations and hard-won routes nobody else has charted.

**Legend:** ● charted only here (no outside source covers it) · *candidate* = vetted, not yet declared in nix-config.

## Routes

| Goal | Route | Note |
|---|---|---|
| ● Audit a config monorepo's foundation | [`foundation-audit`](plugins/foundation-audit) |  |
| ● Author a userscript or diagnose a live web page | [`page-lab`](plugins/page-lab) |  |
| ● Capture what a session figured out, so no session rediscovers it | [`harvest`](plugins/harvest) → `skill-creator` from [claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official) → [`github-release-gate`](plugins/github-release-gate) | harvest triages and lands via PR; skill-creator tests; the gate validates before it ships. |
| ● Encrypt, decrypt, compare and back up OpenPGP material from an agent session | [`pgp-ops`](plugins/pgp-ops) | Plaintext to the clipboard only; passphrase via a real terminal window when the agent has no TTY; every recipient / same-key / round-trip claim proved from the packets. |
| ● Keep the skill library from only growing: find unused skills and retire them | [`skill-curator`](plugins/skill-curator) | Ported from Hermes Agent's curator; retires from the harness via PR, never deletes. |
| ● Make a looping GIF from a video and publish it to Tenor / GIPHY so it shows up in GIF search | [`gif-meme`](plugins/gif-meme) | Needs `media-gif` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.mediaCli.enable) for the encode, and the chrome-devtools MCP attached to a Chromium on --remote-debugging-port=9222 for the two upload forms. Tenor is searchable after a review of up to 48 h; GIPHY never is from a plain account — search placement is an Artist/Brand channel approval, and the application form is gated behind five public uploads. |
| ● Make a repo's default branch a safe, auto-merging release | [`github-release-gate`](plugins/github-release-gate) | Required check first, App-token auto-merge second. |
| ● Operate a physical Android phone over ADB | [`android-phone`](plugins/android-phone) |  |
| ● Reach, or be reached by, another Claude session running concurrently | [`session-relay`](plugins/session-relay) | Own address is in the ListAgents header, not the peer table; most peers are offline; a peer message can never grant escalation. |
| ● Remove a client name, identity or leaked value from a PUBLIC git repo's history without changing the code | [`history-scrub`](plugins/history-scrub) | GitHub's 'Removing sensitive data from a repository' covers the rewrite tool (git-filter-repo) and what survives it; this skill adds the order (fix-forward PR merged first), a SHA-pinned lease, the tip-tree identity proof, and the GitLab hidden-MR-ref trap. Rotate a SECRET at the issuer first. |
| ● Render a PDF that ATS parsers, copy-paste and screen readers read in the right order | [`ats-safe-pdf`](plugins/ats-safe-pdf) | Typst + PDF/UA-1, one column, measured text-layer rules; verify with pdftotext, pdftotext -raw and veraPDF, not by eye. |
| ● Send a formatted message with attachments from a native macOS app | [`mac-app-send`](plugins/mac-app-send) |  |
| ● Send email over SMTP without exposing the sending machine's IP | [`mail-cloak`](plugins/mail-cloak) | Needs msmtp and a SOCKS5 proxy (wireproxy or any other); a human approves every send in the permission prompt. |
| ● Unlock an Android Emulator AVD or enroll its fingerprint | [`android-phone`](plugins/android-phone) |  |
| ● Work on a Nix flake repo with Claude Code | [`nix-dev-toolkit`](plugins/nix-dev-toolkit) → [`nix-flake-kit`](plugins/nix-flake-kit) → [`nixd`](plugins/nixd) |  |
| ● Write up a discovery as one fact-checked document other agents can derive posts, articles and slides from | [`brag-dossier`](plugins/brag-dossier) | Channel formatting is inherited: search the map and indexes for a repurposing skill. |
| Administer a live WordPress site over its REST API | [`wordpress`](plugins/wordpress) | ~59 tools against PRODUCTION — update/delete/settings included, no staging behind it. Starts the launcher you name in its `launcher` setting (on the kattakath fleet, `nix-mcp-wordpress`, which reads the site URL, username and application password from the macOS Keychain at launch; a plugin .mcp.json cannot). NOT the WordPress MCP Adapter: that is a different endpoint (/wp-json/mcp/...) and it is dead — 404 rest_no_route. The core REST path (/wp-json/wp/v2) was verified live 2026-10-02. |
| Answer questions from a local document corpus | [`rag`](plugins/rag) | Declares the `postgres` MCP server itself since 2026-10-02 (it used to come from nix-config's purged gateway). Starts the launcher you name in its `launcher` setting (on the kattakath fleet, `nix-mcp-postgres`) — the launcher knows the loopback URI and the version pins; no secret, the store is trust auth scoped to one database. |
| Author an llms.txt | [`llmstxt`](plugins/llmstxt) |  |
| Build durable workflows on Vercel's Workflow SDK, or migrate to it from Temporal, Inngest, Trigger.dev or AWS Step Functions | [`vercel-workflow`](plugins/vercel-workflow) | Vendored unmodified from vercel/workflow (Apache-2.0, LICENSE shipped in the plugin, no upstream NOTICE), pinned by commit in the plugin README. |
| Check whether a command actually measured what you are about to claim | [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) → [`silent-instruments`](plugins/silent-instruments) | The discipline is off the shelf — obra/superpowers' verification-before-completion skill, cherry-picked by subpath. This covers the instruments its 'check exit code' step assumes are truthful. ShellCheck catches none of them and refuses zsh outright. |
| Debug a failure methodically | [obra/superpowers](https://github.com/obra/superpowers) | systematic-debugging is the adopted skill. |
| Decide whether a perceived gap is worth filling | [`prior-art-recon`](plugins/prior-art-recon) → [claude-plugins-community](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-community) → [Official MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry) | Kill-first. A gap can be real and still wrong to fill — direction, doctrine, alternative, or an artifact of your own design. |
| Find a capability before building or installing one | [`capability-broker`](plugins/capability-broker) → [claude-plugins-community](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-community) → [skills.sh + find-skills](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills) → [Official MCP Registry](https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/registry) | Inventory first; the lightest capability that works wins; adoption goes through nix-config. |
| General language- or domain-specific engineering agents | [wshobson/agents](https://github.com/wshobson/agents) | Candidate; pick single plugins, not the whole collection. |
| Get language-server diagnostics and navigation in shell scripts | [`bash-language-server`](plugins/bash-language-server) | Hook-free: needs bash-language-server and shellcheck on PATH. The community variants install the server over the network at session start. |
| Get scannable, verdict-first answers and architecture maps | [`brain-signals`](plugins/brain-signals) |  |
| Get the keyless utility MCP servers: knowledge graph, step-by-step reasoning | [`mcp-utilities`](plugins/mcp-utilities) | Two pinned upstream servers, no credentials. Terraform and mcpfinder left 2026-11-01: both needed a PATH binary from kattakath/nix-config, so they never worked from this marketplace alone. |
| Keep double-entry books from bank statements: journal, review, reports | [`statement-extract`](plugins/statement-extract) → [`beancount`](plugins/beancount) | statement-extract turns statements into canonical JSONL; beancount builds the journal from it plus rules and decisions, checks it, and serves it read-only in Fava. The journal is derived, never edited. Walked end to end on synthetic data 2026-11-01. |
| Message people on Slack without spamming, duplicating or burying the point | [`slack-etiquette`](plugins/slack-etiquette) | Layers on Slack's own slack:slack-messaging skill; workspace IDs stay in the workspace's CLAUDE.md or memory. |
| Pick, check or enforce a transaction category against a recognised taxonomy | [`plaid-pfc`](plugins/plaid-pfc) | Plaid's PFC v2 (127 detailed names) pinned with descriptions and a v1-to-v2 crosswalk; validate refuses invented names; JSON Schema binds LLM output to the list. Stdlib only, no data. |
| Prepare a job application: analyze the posting, ATS-check the resume, draft the cover letter, prep the interview and the salary talk | [`job-search`](plugins/job-search) | Vendored unmodified from Paramchoudhary/ResumeSkills (MIT), pinned by commit in the plugin README. Prompt-only skills; pair with the resume-tailoring and ATS-PDF routes for the resume itself. |
| Push straight to main and hear about CI only when it breaks | [`ci-watch`](plugins/ci-watch) | asyncRewake hook: silent on green, wakes the session with a resolved report on red, no runs or still running. |
| Rebuild a raster or auto-traced logo as clean, parametric SVG | [`logo-construction-geometry`](plugins/logo-construction-geometry) | Measure centres/radii/angles, infer the construction rule, regenerate from parameters, score IoU vs. the source; walked 2026-09-24 on a figure-8 circuit mark (tolerant IoU 0.90). |
| Run a fleet of repos from one session — dispatch, conquer, implement | [`empire`](plugins/empire) → [`nix-dev-toolkit`](plugins/nix-dev-toolkit) → [`foundation-audit`](plugins/foundation-audit) → [`capability-broker`](plugins/capability-broker) | empire sets the conquest standard and owns none of the tools. There is no controller agent: the session's main agent dispatches. The Senate is a deterministic workflow, and conquest happens on first write, never on read. |
| Run a polite, typed scraping pipeline whose every rule is declared once in pipeline.toml | [`scrape-harness`](plugins/scrape-harness) | Networked runs only with an operator-signed plan; stops become incidents the steward must acknowledge; /scrape-harness:plan-pipeline designs the stages without fetching. |
| Security-review code or a dependency | `security-guidance` from [claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official) → [trailofbits/skills](https://github.com/trailofbits/skills) |  |
| Supervise Claude Code hooks so one bad hook cannot wedge a session | [`superhook`](plugins/superhook) |  |
| Tailor a resume to a job posting | [`jsonresume-tailor`](plugins/jsonresume-tailor) |  |
| Turn a repo's review history into agent instructions | `ai-ready` from [johnpapa/ai-ready](https://github.com/johnpapa/ai-ready) | Candidate; not declared in nix-config yet. |
| Turn bank/card statements into reconciled, deduplicated transaction records | [`statement-extract`](plugins/statement-extract) | Fails closed (exit 3/4/5) rather than emit an unreconciled or unmasked row. QFX/OFX adapters for TD, CIBC, Scotiabank and Tangerine; PDF adapters for the same banks plus Desjardins Visa, Wise and closed Scotiabank and BMO chequing accounts; a declarative CSV driver with a Wise adapter (keys byte-identical to the legacy extractor); loan and mortgage balance snapshots (TD, CIBC, BMO, NSLSC) as opt-in position records. Sinks (a Sheet, a ledger) stay with the consumer. |
